memoryBox.stripeCheckoutNote: After you submit, you’ll pay {price} securely via Stripe Checkout. Your box request is saved first — payment is confirmed only after Checkout succeeds.
memoryBox.requestNote: This form submits an {orderRequest} (not an online payment). We’ll email you to collect the $199 fee before shipping.
memoryBox.signedInHint: Signed in — this order will be linked to your account so completed uploads can appear in your Photos page.
memoryBox.guestHint: Not signed in? Please use a name, email, and phone we can reach — we need them to match your order when digitized files are ready.
memoryBox.estimatesHint: Best guesses are fine — we’ll confirm once your box arrives.
memoryBox.specialInstructionsPlaceholder: Fragile albums, labeling preferences, anything we should know…
memoryBox.estimatesAck: I understand these counts are approximate, processing takes about 5–8 weeks after you receive my filled box, and digitized media will appear automatically in Photos when ready.
memoryBox.errorConfirmMissing: Order was saved, but we couldn’t open the confirmation page.
memoryBox.errorNetwork: Could not submit your order. Check your connection and try again.
memoryBox.confirmTitle: Your Family Memory Box order is confirmed
memoryBox.leadPaid: You’re all set. We’ll email shipping details soon, and take good care of what’s in the box.
memoryBox.leadPaidWithPrice: You’re all set — {price} received. We’ll email shipping details soon, and take good care of what’s in the box.
memoryBox.leadManual: Thank you. We’ve saved your request. Payment was not taken online — we’ll email you to collect the $199 fee before we ship your box.
memoryBox.leadDefault: Thank you. We’ve received your order details and will be in touch by email.
memoryBox.nextStep1: Expect your Family Memory Box within about {weeks}.
memoryBox.nextStep1AfterPayment: Expect your Family Memory Box within about {weeks} after payment is confirmed.
memoryBox.nextStep2: After you return it filled, allow about {weeks} for processing.
memoryBox.nextStep3: Digitized items will appear in {photos} when ready — automatically, no upload needed.
memoryBox.orderNotFoundLead: We couldn’t find that confirmation link. If you just ordered, check your email or return to the Memory Box page.
memoryBox.orderNotFoundLeadLoad: We couldn’t load that order. If you just submitted a request, try again from your confirmation email or contact us.
memoryBox.paymentPendingNote: If you completed Checkout, your payment may still be confirming. Your order details are saved — you can refresh this page in a moment.
memoryBox.successMetaDescription: Your Family Memory Box order confirmation and what happens next.
